verdict.rationale: Gmail's own Gemini assistant documents grounded help over mailbox content: it summarizes long threads into bullet points, acts on emails, and uses Google Calendar availability to propose meeting times. Nothing shows free-form questions across the whole inbox and calendar, such as who said what or what is still outstanding. Missing for 10: documented cross-inbox natural-language Q&A, querying calendar contents (not just availability for scheduling), citations or grounding of answers to source messages, outstanding-items tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
